Last updated: 2026-07-05 · Full GB output rebuild: 2026-07-04.
:::

Figures summarising the main outputs of the risk model, without the modelling
detail. The map is *exposure-adjusted*: it reflects risk given traffic, not
simply where the most collisions happen. Full methodology and diagnostics are
on the [Stage 2 model](../analysis/model-results.qmd) page.

The modelled-risk map is not the same as a simple collision-rate map. Traffic
volume is a major driver of collision frequency, so modelled risk can still
resemble the traffic-volume surface. The diagnostic maps below add two
comparators: a crude rate map showing collisions per unit exposure, and an
observed-vs-expected map showing where collision occurrence is higher or lower
than expected after accounting for exposure and the available road/network
context.

The map defaults to equal-size 10 km grid cells across Great Britain. It also
includes a simplified GB-wide named reporting-area layer for optional display
context. Those named areas are dissolved for legibility only: they are not
formal modelling units, validation units, or administrative reporting units.
Public-facing values are shown as percentiles or medians rather than calibrated
expected collision counts.

## Reporting-area map geography

The full GB key-figures map now has a GB-wide reporting-area layer. This is a
presentation layer built from local-authority / council-area boundaries and
dissolved into larger reporting areas where useful.

This layer is still being refined. The main comparison geography remains the
10 km grid, because it is consistent across Great Britain. The named-area view
is intended for readability, not as the primary modelling unit.

```{python}
#| label: interactive-risk-map

import geopandas as gpd
import folium
import branca.colormap as bcm
from branca.element import MacroElement, Template
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import pyarrow.parquet as pq
from pathlib import Path
from pyproj import datadir
from shapely.geometry import box
import sys

from road_risk.config import _ROOT as ROOT

SHADES = ["#f6ddc9", "#e7b48d", "#d4844f", "#b25636", "#7c3122"]
GRID_M = 10_000
MIN_GRID_LINKS = 20

proj_dir = Path(sys.prefix) / "share/proj"
if proj_dir.exists():
    datadir.set_data_dir(str(proj_dir))

GB_CENTRE = [54.6, -3.2]

area_paths = [
    ROOT / "quarto/outputs/reporting_areas_gb.geojson",
]
area_path = next((path for path in area_paths if path.exists()), None)
if area_path is None:
    checked = "\n".join(str(path) for path in area_paths)
    raise FileNotFoundError(f"Could not find reporting_areas_gb.geojson. Checked:\n{checked}")
areas = gpd.read_file(area_path).to_crs(27700)
reporting_areas = areas.copy()

risk_path = ROOT / "data/models/risk_scores.parquet"
if not risk_path.exists():
    risk_path = ROOT / "data/models/risk_scores_eb.parquet"
risk_columns_available = set(pq.ParquetFile(risk_path).schema_arrow.names)
risk_columns = [
    col
    for col in [
        "link_id",
        "risk_percentile",
        "estimated_aadt",
        "collision_count",
        "predicted_xgb",
        "n_years",
    ]
    if col in risk_columns_available
]
missing_required = {
    "link_id",
    "risk_percentile",
    "estimated_aadt",
    "collision_count",
    "predicted_xgb",
} - set(risk_columns)
if missing_required:
    raise KeyError(f"{risk_path.relative_to(ROOT)} is missing columns: {sorted(missing_required)}")
risk = pd.read_parquet(risk_path, columns=risk_columns)
if "n_years" not in risk.columns:
    # The production risk score is pooled from the same all-link scoring panel
    # for each year, so the scoring-period length is common across links here.
    aadt_years = pd.read_parquet(
        ROOT / "data/models/aadt_estimates.parquet",
        columns=["year"],
    )
    risk["n_years"] = int(aadt_years["year"].nunique())
roads = gpd.read_parquet(
    ROOT / "data/processed/shapefiles/openroads.parquet",
    columns=["link_id", "link_length_km", "geometry"],
)
links = roads.merge(risk, on="link_id", how="inner")
links = links[links.geometry.notna()].to_crs(27700)
links["collision_count"] = pd.to_numeric(links["collision_count"], errors="coerce").fillna(0)
links["estimated_aadt"] = pd.to_numeric(links["estimated_aadt"], errors="coerce")
links["link_length_km"] = pd.to_numeric(links["link_length_km"], errors="coerce")
links["n_years"] = pd.to_numeric(links["n_years"], errors="coerce")
links["predicted_xgb"] = pd.to_numeric(links["predicted_xgb"], errors="coerce")
links["exposure_vehicle_km"] = (
    links["estimated_aadt"] * links["link_length_km"] * 365 * links["n_years"]
)
links["expected_collisions"] = links["predicted_xgb"] * links["n_years"]
link_points = links.copy()
link_points["geometry"] = link_points.geometry.representative_point()

OE_CONTINUITY = 0.5


def add_diagnostic_metrics(frame):
    frame = frame.copy()
    frame["crude_rate_per_million_vkm"] = np.where(
        frame["exposure_vehicle_km"] > 0,
        frame["observed_collisions"] / frame["exposure_vehicle_km"] * 1_000_000,
        np.nan,
    )
    frame["log_oe"] = np.log(
        (frame["observed_collisions"] + OE_CONTINUITY)
        / (frame["expected_collisions"] + OE_CONTINUITY)
    )
    frame["oe_ratio"] = np.exp(frame["log_oe"])
    frame["exposure_million_vkm"] = frame["exposure_vehicle_km"] / 1_000_000
    return frame

area_join = gpd.sjoin(
    link_points,
    areas[["area_name", "reporting_area", "geometry"]],
    how="inner",
    predicate="within",
)
area_stats = (
    area_join.groupby("reporting_area")
    .agg(
        scored_links=("link_id", "size"),
        median_risk=("risk_percentile", "median"),
        median_traffic=("estimated_aadt", "median"),
        observed_collisions=("collision_count", "sum"),
        exposure_vehicle_km=("exposure_vehicle_km", "sum"),
        expected_collisions=("expected_collisions", "sum"),
    )
    .reset_index()
)
area_stats = add_diagnostic_metrics(area_stats)
area_plot = reporting_areas.merge(
    area_stats,
    on="reporting_area",
    how="left",
)
area_plot["median_risk"] = area_plot["median_risk"].round(1)
area_plot["median_traffic"] = area_plot["median_traffic"].round(0)
area_plot["observed_collisions"] = area_plot["observed_collisions"].round(0)
area_plot["expected_collisions"] = area_plot["expected_collisions"].round(1)
area_plot["exposure_million_vkm"] = area_plot["exposure_million_vkm"].round(1)
area_plot["crude_rate_per_million_vkm"] = area_plot["crude_rate_per_million_vkm"].round(3)
area_plot["log_oe"] = area_plot["log_oe"].round(3)
area_plot["oe_ratio"] = area_plot["oe_ratio"].round(2)
area_plot["scored_links"] = area_plot["scored_links"].fillna(0).astype(int)

centroids = link_points.geometry
grid_df = pd.DataFrame({
    "grid_x": np.floor(centroids.x / GRID_M) * GRID_M,
    "grid_y": np.floor(centroids.y / GRID_M) * GRID_M,
    "risk_percentile": link_points["risk_percentile"].to_numpy(),
    "estimated_aadt": link_points["estimated_aadt"].to_numpy(),
    "collision_count": link_points["collision_count"].to_numpy(),
    "exposure_vehicle_km": link_points["exposure_vehicle_km"].to_numpy(),
    "expected_collisions": link_points["expected_collisions"].to_numpy(),
})
grid_stats = (
    grid_df.groupby(["grid_x", "grid_y"])
    .agg(
        scored_links=("risk_percentile", "size"),
        median_risk=("risk_percentile", "median"),
        median_traffic=("estimated_aadt", "median"),
        observed_collisions=("collision_count", "sum"),
        exposure_vehicle_km=("exposure_vehicle_km", "sum"),
        expected_collisions=("expected_collisions", "sum"),
    )
    .reset_index()
)
grid_stats = grid_stats[grid_stats["scored_links"] >= MIN_GRID_LINKS].copy()
grid_stats = add_diagnostic_metrics(grid_stats)
grid_stats["geometry"] = [
    box(x, y, x + GRID_M, y + GRID_M)
    for x, y in zip(grid_stats["grid_x"], grid_stats["grid_y"])
]
grid_plot = gpd.GeoDataFrame(grid_stats, geometry="geometry", crs="EPSG:27700")
grid_plot["median_risk"] = grid_plot["median_risk"].round(1)
grid_plot["median_traffic"] = grid_plot["median_traffic"].round(0)
grid_plot["observed_collisions"] = grid_plot["observed_collisions"].round(0)
grid_plot["expected_collisions"] = grid_plot["expected_collisions"].round(1)
grid_plot["exposure_million_vkm"] = grid_plot["exposure_million_vkm"].round(1)
grid_plot["crude_rate_per_million_vkm"] = grid_plot["crude_rate_per_million_vkm"].round(3)
grid_plot["log_oe"] = grid_plot["log_oe"].round(3)
grid_plot["oe_ratio"] = grid_plot["oe_ratio"].round(2)
grid_plot["scored_links"] = grid_plot["scored_links"].astype(int)

area_values_nonnull = area_plot["median_risk"].dropna()
area_edges = np.quantile(area_values_nonnull, np.linspace(0, 1, len(SHADES) + 1))
if len(np.unique(area_edges)) != len(area_edges):
    area_edges = np.linspace(area_values_nonnull.min(), area_values_nonnull.max(), len(SHADES) + 1)
area_edges[0] -= 1e-9
area_edges[-1] += 1e-9


def area_colour(value):
    if pd.isna(value):
        return "#eeeeee"
    index = np.searchsorted(area_edges[1:], value, side="right")
    return SHADES[min(index, len(SHADES) - 1)]


grid_values = grid_plot["median_risk"].dropna()
grid_vmin, grid_vmax = grid_values.quantile([0.02, 0.98])
if grid_vmin == grid_vmax:
    grid_vmin, grid_vmax = grid_values.min(), grid_values.max()
grid_colour = bcm.LinearColormap(SHADES, vmin=float(grid_vmin), vmax=float(grid_vmax))
grid_colour.caption = "Median exposure-adjusted risk percentile"

area_plot_wgs84 = area_plot.to_crs(4326)
grid_plot_wgs84 = grid_plot.to_crs(4326)
reporting_boundaries_wgs84 = reporting_areas.to_crs(4326)
fit_geometries = gpd.GeoSeries(
    pd.concat(
        [
            grid_plot_wgs84.geometry,
            reporting_boundaries_wgs84.geometry,
        ],
        ignore_index=True,
    ),
    crs=4326,
)
min_lon, min_lat, max_lon, max_lat = fit_geometries.total_bounds

# Bias the opening view toward mainland GB; the full island geometry remains pannable.
INITIAL_VIEW_MAX_LAT = 58.85
initial_max_lat = min(float(max_lat), INITIAL_VIEW_MAX_LAT)

GB_FIT_BOUNDS = [
    [float(min_lat), float(min_lon)],
    [initial_max_lat, float(max_lon)],
]
GB_CENTRE = [
    float((min_lat + initial_max_lat) / 2),
    float((min_lon + max_lon) / 2),
]

risk_map = folium.Map(
    location=GB_CENTRE,
    zoom_start=6,
    zoom_snap=0.1,
    zoom_delta=0.1,
    width="100%",
    height="720px",
    tiles=None,
    control_scale=True,
)
basemap_layer = folium.TileLayer("CartoDB positron", name="Light basemap", control=False)
basemap_layer.add_to(risk_map)

area_layer = folium.FeatureGroup(name="Reporting areas", show=False)
folium.GeoJson(
    area_plot_wgs84[["reporting_area", "median_risk", "scored_links", "geometry"]],
    name="Reporting areas",
    style_function=lambda feature: {
        "fillColor": area_colour(feature["properties"]["median_risk"]),
        "color": "#ffffff",
        "weight": 0.9,
        "fillOpacity": 0.78,
    },
    highlight_function=lambda feature: {
        "weight": 1.8,
        "color": "#222222",
        "fillOpacity": 0.86,
    },
    tooltip=folium.GeoJsonTooltip(
        fields=["reporting_area", "median_risk", "scored_links"],
        aliases=["Reporting area", "Median risk percentile", "Scored links"],
        localize=True,
        sticky=False,
    ),
).add_to(area_layer)
area_layer.add_to(risk_map)

grid_layer = folium.FeatureGroup(name="10 km grid", show=True)
folium.GeoJson(
    grid_plot_wgs84[["median_risk", "scored_links", "geometry"]],
    name="10 km grid",
    style_function=lambda feature: {
        "fillColor": grid_colour(feature["properties"]["median_risk"]),
        "color": "#6c6c6c",
        "weight": 0.25,
        "fillOpacity": 0.5,
    },
    highlight_function=lambda feature: {
        "weight": 1.2,
        "color": "#222222",
        "fillOpacity": 0.68,
    },
    tooltip=folium.GeoJsonTooltip(
        fields=["median_risk", "scored_links"],
        aliases=["Median risk percentile", "Scored links"],
        localize=True,
        sticky=False,
    ),
).add_to(grid_layer)
grid_layer.add_to(risk_map)

boundary_layer = folium.FeatureGroup(name="Reporting boundaries", show=False)
folium.GeoJson(
    reporting_boundaries_wgs84[["reporting_area", "geometry"]],
    name="Reporting boundaries",
    style_function=lambda feature: {
        "fillOpacity": 0,
        "color": "#333333",
        "weight": 0.8,
    },
    tooltip=folium.GeoJsonTooltip(fields=["reporting_area"], aliases=["Reporting area"], sticky=False),
).add_to(boundary_layer)
boundary_layer.add_to(risk_map)

class ModeButtons(MacroElement):
    def __init__(self, area_layer, grid_layer, boundary_layer, basemap_layer, legend_title, legend_gradient):
        super().__init__()
        self._name = "ModeButtons"
        self.area_layer = area_layer.get_name()
        self.grid_layer = grid_layer.get_name()
        self.boundary_layer = boundary_layer.get_name()
        self.basemap_layer = basemap_layer.get_name()
        self.legend_title = legend_title
        self.legend_gradient = legend_gradient
        self._template = Template("""
        {% macro header(this, kwargs) %}
        <style>
          .risk-mode-control {
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.96);
            border: 1px solid #c8d0dc;
            border-radius: 8px;
            box-shadow: 0 1px 5px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.18);
            display: grid;
            gap: 0.35rem;
            padding: 0.55rem;
          }
          .risk-mode-control-title {
            color: #405064;
            font: 700 0.72rem/1.1 system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
            margin: 0.1rem 0 0.05rem;
            text-transform: uppercase;
          }
          .risk-mode-control button {
            background: #ffffff;
            border: 1px solid #b8c2d0;
            border-radius: 6px;
            color: #17202a;
            cursor: pointer;
            font: 600 0.82rem/1.2 system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
            min-width: 9.6rem;
            padding: 0.42rem 0.55rem;
            text-align: left;
          }
          .risk-mode-control button.active {
            background: #243447;
            border-color: #243447;
            color: #ffffff;
          }
          .risk-map-legend {
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.94);
            border: 1px solid #c8d0dc;
            border-radius: 8px;
            box-shadow: 0 1px 5px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.18);
            color: #243447;
            font: 0.78rem/1.25 system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
            padding: 0.55rem 0.65rem;
            width: 13rem;
          }
          .risk-map-legend-gradient {
            background: {{ this.legend_gradient }};
            height: 0.55rem;
            margin: 0.35rem 0;
            width: 100%;
          }
          .risk-map-legend-labels {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
          }
        </style>
        {% endmacro %}
        {% macro script(this, kwargs) %}
        (function() {
        const activeMap = {{ this._parent.get_name() }};
        const areaLayer = {{ this.area_layer }};
        const gridLayer = {{ this.grid_layer }};
        const boundaryLayer = {{ this.boundary_layer }};
        const basemapLayer = {{ this.basemap_layer }};
        const modeControl = L.control({ position: "topright" });
        const legendControl = L.control({ position: "bottomright" });

        modeControl.onAdd = function() {
          const div = L.DomUtil.create("div", "risk-mode-control");
          div.innerHTML = `
            <div class="risk-mode-control-title">Map view</div>
            <button type="button" data-risk-mode="areas">Reporting areas</button>
            <button type="button" data-risk-mode="grid" class="active">10 km grid</button>
            <button type="button" data-risk-mode="grid-boundaries">Grid + boundaries</button>
            <div class="risk-mode-control-title">Background</div>
            <button type="button" data-base-mode="light" class="active">Light basemap</button>
            <button type="button" data-base-mode="none">No basemap</button>
          `;
          L.DomEvent.disableClickPropagation(div);
          L.DomEvent.disableScrollPropagation(div);
          div.querySelectorAll("[data-risk-mode]").forEach((button) => {
            L.DomEvent.on(button, "click", (event) => {
              L.DomEvent.stop(event);
              setRiskMode(button.dataset.riskMode, div);
            });
          });
          div.querySelectorAll("[data-base-mode]").forEach((button) => {
            L.DomEvent.on(button, "click", (event) => {
              L.DomEvent.stop(event);
              setBaseMode(button.dataset.baseMode, div);
            });
          });
          return div;
        };
        modeControl.addTo(activeMap);

        legendControl.onAdd = function() {
          const div = L.DomUtil.create("div", "risk-map-legend");
          div.innerHTML = `
            <strong>{{ this.legend_title }}</strong>
            <div class="risk-map-legend-gradient"></div>
            <div class="risk-map-legend-labels"><span>Lower</span><span>Higher</span></div>
          `;
          L.DomEvent.disableClickPropagation(div);
          L.DomEvent.disableScrollPropagation(div);
          return div;
        };
        legendControl.addTo(activeMap);

        function setRiskMode(mode, root) {
          if (activeMap.hasLayer(areaLayer)) activeMap.removeLayer(areaLayer);
          if (activeMap.hasLayer(gridLayer)) activeMap.removeLayer(gridLayer);
          if (activeMap.hasLayer(boundaryLayer)) activeMap.removeLayer(boundaryLayer);

          if (mode === "areas") {
            activeMap.addLayer(areaLayer);
          } else if (mode === "grid") {
            activeMap.addLayer(gridLayer);
          } else {
            activeMap.addLayer(gridLayer);
            activeMap.addLayer(boundaryLayer);
          }

          root.querySelectorAll("[data-risk-mode]").forEach((button) => {
            button.classList.toggle("active", button.dataset.riskMode === mode);
          });
        }

        function setBaseMode(mode, root) {
          if (mode === "none" && activeMap.hasLayer(basemapLayer)) {
            activeMap.removeLayer(basemapLayer);
          }
          if (mode === "light" && !activeMap.hasLayer(basemapLayer)) {
            activeMap.addLayer(basemapLayer);
            basemapLayer.bringToBack();
          }
          root.querySelectorAll("[data-base-mode]").forEach((button) => {
            button.classList.toggle("active", button.dataset.baseMode === mode);
          });
        }
        })();
        {% endmacro %}
        """)


risk_map.add_child(ModeButtons(
    area_layer,
    grid_layer,
    boundary_layer,
    basemap_layer,
    "Median risk percentile",
    "linear-gradient(90deg, #f6ddc9, #e7b48d, #d4844f, #b25636, #7c3122)",
))
risk_map.fit_bounds(GB_FIT_BOUNDS, padding=(0, 0))
risk_map
```

### Traffic volume

The map below uses the same geography and controls, but colours areas by median
estimated AADT rather than modelled risk.

```{python}
#| label: interactive-traffic-map

TRAFFIC_SHADES = ["#edf8fb", "#b2e2e2", "#66c2a4", "#2ca25f", "#006d2c"]

traffic_values_nonnull = area_plot["median_traffic"].dropna()
traffic_area_edges = np.quantile(traffic_values_nonnull, np.linspace(0, 1, len(TRAFFIC_SHADES) + 1))
if len(np.unique(traffic_area_edges)) != len(traffic_area_edges):
    traffic_area_edges = np.linspace(
        traffic_values_nonnull.min(),
        traffic_values_nonnull.max(),
        len(TRAFFIC_SHADES) + 1,
    )
traffic_area_edges[0] -= 1e-9
traffic_area_edges[-1] += 1e-9


def traffic_area_colour(value):
    if pd.isna(value):
        return "#eeeeee"
    index = np.searchsorted(traffic_area_edges[1:], value, side="right")
    return TRAFFIC_SHADES[min(index, len(TRAFFIC_SHADES) - 1)]


traffic_grid_values = grid_plot["median_traffic"].dropna()
traffic_grid_vmin, traffic_grid_vmax = traffic_grid_values.quantile([0.02, 0.98])
if traffic_grid_vmin == traffic_grid_vmax:
    traffic_grid_vmin, traffic_grid_vmax = traffic_grid_values.min(), traffic_grid_values.max()
traffic_colour = bcm.LinearColormap(
    TRAFFIC_SHADES,
    vmin=float(traffic_grid_vmin),
    vmax=float(traffic_grid_vmax),
)

traffic_map = folium.Map(
    location=GB_CENTRE,
    zoom_start=6,
    zoom_snap=0.1,
    zoom_delta=0.1,
    width="100%",
    height="720px",
    tiles=None,
    control_scale=True,
)
traffic_basemap_layer = folium.TileLayer("CartoDB positron", name="Light basemap", control=False)
traffic_basemap_layer.add_to(traffic_map)

traffic_area_layer = folium.FeatureGroup(name="Reporting areas", show=False)
folium.GeoJson(
    area_plot_wgs84[["reporting_area", "median_traffic", "scored_links", "geometry"]],
    name="Reporting areas",
    style_function=lambda feature: {
        "fillColor": traffic_area_colour(feature["properties"]["median_traffic"]),
        "color": "#ffffff",
        "weight": 0.9,
        "fillOpacity": 0.78,
    },
    highlight_function=lambda feature: {
        "weight": 1.8,
        "color": "#222222",
        "fillOpacity": 0.86,
    },
    tooltip=folium.GeoJsonTooltip(
        fields=["reporting_area", "median_traffic", "scored_links"],
        aliases=["Reporting area", "Median estimated AADT", "Scored links"],
        localize=True,
        sticky=False,
    ),
).add_to(traffic_area_layer)
traffic_area_layer.add_to(traffic_map)

traffic_grid_layer = folium.FeatureGroup(name="10 km grid", show=True)
folium.GeoJson(
    grid_plot_wgs84[["median_traffic", "scored_links", "geometry"]],
    name="10 km grid",
    style_function=lambda feature: {
        "fillColor": traffic_colour(feature["properties"]["median_traffic"]),
        "color": "#6c6c6c",
        "weight": 0.25,
        "fillOpacity": 0.5,
    },
    highlight_function=lambda feature: {
        "weight": 1.2,
        "color": "#222222",
        "fillOpacity": 0.68,
    },
    tooltip=folium.GeoJsonTooltip(
        fields=["median_traffic", "scored_links"],
        aliases=["Median estimated AADT", "Scored links"],
        localize=True,
        sticky=False,
    ),
).add_to(traffic_grid_layer)
traffic_grid_layer.add_to(traffic_map)

traffic_boundary_layer = folium.FeatureGroup(name="Reporting boundaries", show=False)
folium.GeoJson(
    reporting_boundaries_wgs84[["reporting_area", "geometry"]],
    name="Reporting boundaries",
    style_function=lambda feature: {
        "fillOpacity": 0,
        "color": "#333333",
        "weight": 0.8,
    },
    tooltip=folium.GeoJsonTooltip(fields=["reporting_area"], aliases=["Reporting area"], sticky=False),
).add_to(traffic_boundary_layer)
traffic_boundary_layer.add_to(traffic_map)

traffic_map.add_child(ModeButtons(
    traffic_area_layer,
    traffic_grid_layer,
    traffic_boundary_layer,
    traffic_basemap_layer,
    "Median estimated AADT",
    "linear-gradient(90deg, #edf8fb, #b2e2e2, #66c2a4, #2ca25f, #006d2c)",
))
traffic_map.fit_bounds(GB_FIT_BOUNDS, padding=(0, 0))
traffic_map
```

### Crude collision rate per million vehicle-km

This is a transparent baseline: observed injury collisions divided by estimated
vehicle-km travelled. It is useful because it shows collisions per unit
exposure, but it can be noisy where exposure is low.

```{python}
#| label: interactive-crude-rate-map

CRUDE_SHADES = ["#f7fbff", "#c6dbef", "#6baed6", "#2171b5", "#08306b"]
OE_SHADES = ["#2166ac", "#f7f7f7", "#b2182b"]


def unique_columns(columns):
    return list(dict.fromkeys(columns))


def quantile_edges(values, n_shades):
    edges = np.quantile(values, np.linspace(0, 1, n_shades + 1))
    if len(np.unique(edges)) != len(edges):
        edges = np.linspace(values.min(), values.max(), n_shades + 1)
    edges[0] -= 1e-9
    edges[-1] += 1e-9
    return edges


def binned_colour(value, edges, shades):
    if pd.isna(value):
        return "#eeeeee"
    index = np.searchsorted(edges[1:], value, side="right")
    return shades[min(index, len(shades) - 1)]


def metric_colour_scales(metric, shades, diverging=False):
    area_values = area_plot[metric].dropna()
    grid_values = grid_plot[metric].dropna()
    if diverging:
        all_values = pd.concat([area_values, grid_values], ignore_index=True)
        max_abs = float(all_values.abs().quantile(0.98))
        if max_abs <= 0 or pd.isna(max_abs):
            max_abs = float(all_values.abs().max())
        if max_abs <= 0 or pd.isna(max_abs):
            max_abs = 1.0
        colour = bcm.LinearColormap(shades, vmin=-max_abs, vmax=max_abs)

        def area_colour(value):
            if pd.isna(value):
                return "#eeeeee"
            return colour(float(np.clip(value, -max_abs, max_abs)))

        return area_colour, colour

    area_edges = quantile_edges(area_values, len(shades))

    def area_colour(value):
        return binned_colour(value, area_edges, shades)

    grid_vmin, grid_vmax = grid_values.quantile([0.02, 0.98])
    if grid_vmin == grid_vmax:
        grid_vmin, grid_vmax = grid_values.min(), grid_values.max()
    return area_colour, bcm.LinearColormap(shades, vmin=float(grid_vmin), vmax=float(grid_vmax))


def diagnostic_map(
    metric,
    legend_title,
    legend_gradient,
    shades,
    area_fields,
    area_aliases,
    grid_fields,
    grid_aliases,
    diverging=False,
):
    area_colour, grid_colour = metric_colour_scales(metric, shades, diverging=diverging)

    active_map = folium.Map(
        location=GB_CENTRE,
        zoom_start=6,
        zoom_snap=0.1,
        zoom_delta=0.1,
        width="100%",
        height="720px",
        tiles=None,
        control_scale=True,
    )
    active_basemap_layer = folium.TileLayer(
        "CartoDB positron",
        name="Light basemap",
        control=False,
    )
    active_basemap_layer.add_to(active_map)

    active_area_layer = folium.FeatureGroup(name="Reporting areas", show=False)
    folium.GeoJson(
        area_plot_wgs84[unique_columns([*area_fields, "geometry"])],
        name="Reporting areas",
        style_function=lambda feature: {
            "fillColor": area_colour(feature["properties"][metric]),
            "color": "#ffffff",
            "weight": 0.9,
            "fillOpacity": 0.78,
        },
        highlight_function=lambda feature: {
            "weight": 1.8,
            "color": "#222222",
            "fillOpacity": 0.86,
        },
        tooltip=folium.GeoJsonTooltip(
            fields=area_fields,
            aliases=area_aliases,
            localize=True,
            sticky=False,
        ),
    ).add_to(active_area_layer)
    active_area_layer.add_to(active_map)

    active_grid_layer = folium.FeatureGroup(name="10 km grid", show=True)
    folium.GeoJson(
        grid_plot_wgs84[unique_columns([*grid_fields, "geometry"])],
        name="10 km grid",
        style_function=lambda feature: {
            "fillColor": grid_colour(feature["properties"][metric]),
            "color": "#6c6c6c",
            "weight": 0.25,
            "fillOpacity": 0.5,
        },
        highlight_function=lambda feature: {
            "weight": 1.2,
            "color": "#222222",
            "fillOpacity": 0.68,
        },
        tooltip=folium.GeoJsonTooltip(
            fields=grid_fields,
            aliases=grid_aliases,
            localize=True,
            sticky=False,
        ),
    ).add_to(active_grid_layer)
    active_grid_layer.add_to(active_map)

    active_boundary_layer = folium.FeatureGroup(name="Reporting boundaries", show=False)
    folium.GeoJson(
        reporting_boundaries_wgs84[["reporting_area", "geometry"]],
        name="Reporting boundaries",
        style_function=lambda feature: {
            "fillOpacity": 0,
            "color": "#333333",
            "weight": 0.8,
        },
        tooltip=folium.GeoJsonTooltip(
            fields=["reporting_area"],
            aliases=["Reporting area"],
            sticky=False,
        ),
    ).add_to(active_boundary_layer)
    active_boundary_layer.add_to(active_map)

    active_map.add_child(ModeButtons(
        active_area_layer,
        active_grid_layer,
        active_boundary_layer,
        active_basemap_layer,
        legend_title,
        legend_gradient,
    ))
    active_map.fit_bounds(GB_FIT_BOUNDS, padding=(0, 0))
    return active_map


crude_rate_map = diagnostic_map(
    "crude_rate_per_million_vkm",
    "Crude collision rate per million vehicle-km",
    "linear-gradient(90deg, #f7fbff, #c6dbef, #6baed6, #2171b5, #08306b)",
    CRUDE_SHADES,
    [
        "reporting_area",
        "crude_rate_per_million_vkm",
        "observed_collisions",
        "exposure_million_vkm",
        "scored_links",
    ],
    [
        "Reporting area",
        "Crude collision rate per million vehicle-km",
        "Observed collisions",
        "Exposure, million vehicle-km",
        "Scored links",
    ],
    [
        "crude_rate_per_million_vkm",
        "observed_collisions",
        "exposure_million_vkm",
        "scored_links",
    ],
    [
        "Crude collision rate per million vehicle-km",
        "Observed collisions",
        "Exposure, million vehicle-km",
        "Scored links",
    ],
)
crude_rate_map
```

### Higher/lower collision occurrence than expected from the exposure-adjusted model

This map compares observed collisions with model-expected collisions on the
same public geography. It is the clearest diagnostic view of where collision
occurrence is higher or lower than expected after accounting for exposure and
the available road/network context. It should not be read as "true risk".

```{python}
#| label: interactive-observed-expected-map

oe_map = diagnostic_map(
    "log_oe",
    "Higher/lower collision occurrence than expected from the exposure-adjusted model",
    "linear-gradient(90deg, #2166ac, #f7f7f7, #b2182b)",
    OE_SHADES,
    [
        "reporting_area",
        "log_oe",
        "oe_ratio",
        "observed_collisions",
        "expected_collisions",
        "scored_links",
    ],
    [
        "Reporting area",
        "Log observed/expected",
        "Observed/expected ratio",
        "Observed collisions",
        "Expected collisions",
        "Scored links",
    ],
    [
        "log_oe",
        "oe_ratio",
        "observed_collisions",
        "expected_collisions",
        "scored_links",
    ],
    [
        "Log observed/expected",
        "Observed/expected ratio",
        "Observed collisions",
        "Expected collisions",
        "Scored links",
    ],
    diverging=True,
)
oe_map
```

Crude rates and observed/expected ratios can be unstable in low-exposure or
low-count areas, so these maps should be read as diagnostics rather than
definitive site rankings.

### Diagnostic correlations

The table below is calculated on the 10 km grid cells shown above. Aggregated
traffic volume is represented by median estimated AADT, matching the traffic
map.

```{python}
#| label: diagnostic-correlations

def spearman_row(label, left, right):
    values = grid_plot[[left, right]].dropna()
    return {
        "Comparison": label,
        "Spearman rho": round(float(values[left].corr(values[right], method="spearman")), 3),
        "Grid cells": int(len(values)),
    }


pd.DataFrame([
    spearman_row(
        "Traffic volume vs modelled risk",
        "median_traffic",
        "median_risk",
    ),
    spearman_row(
        "Crude collision rate vs modelled risk",
        "crude_rate_per_million_vkm",
        "median_risk",
    ),
    spearman_row(
        "Traffic volume vs O/E excess",
        "median_traffic",
        "log_oe",
    ),
])
```

The 10 km grid is the primary consistent public geography. The named-area view
uses a simplified GB-wide display geography generated by
`scripts/build_reporting_areas_gb.py`; compact urban and county-style
authorities are dissolved where that makes the map legible. The grid view omits
cells with fewer than 20 scored links.
